The dashboard is ready at [dashboard.html](file:///Users/sabpap/Workspace/Clients/Laurium/pod-ai-variants/2-manual/dashboard.html) [📁](file:///Users/sabpap/Workspace/Clients/Laurium/pod-ai-variants/2-manual/).

To use it, serve it locally (file:// can't reach the WebSocket):

```
cd /Users/sabpap/Workspace/Clients/Laurium/pod-ai-variants/2-manual
python3 -m http.server 8371
```

Then open **http://localhost:8371/dashboard.html**.

**What it does:**

- **Account section** — shows your account value ($19.72), cash, unrealized P&L, and lifetime P&L, updated live via `pod_positions`
- **Positions table** — lists open perp positions with side, size, entry/mark prices, P&L, and liquidation price (currently empty)
- **Market cards** — NVDA, AAPL, GLD with live mark prices, 24h change, volume, open interest, and a mini price-tick chart that fills in as updates stream
- **NVDA 1% alert** — when NVDA's mark price moves 1% from its reference (set on page load), a banner drops down and a browser notification fires. After each alert the reference resets, with a 60-second cooldown to avoid spam. The browser will ask for notification permission on first load.

Everything streams live over pod's WebSocket with reconnection, duplicate-drop, and resume-from-last-round built in.
